title: Inferlo jobs on an existing BullMQ queue
prompt: This company runs all its background work on BullMQ and wants Inferlo's jobs in the same Redis and dashboards. Create src/job-queue.ts with `export function jobQueue(queue: BullMQQueue, worker: BullMQWorker)` (both types from @browserlessapi/inferlo/bullmq; the queue and worker come from bullmq) that returns the `jobQueue` option for createApp, keeping Inferlo's jobs in that BullMQ queue with Inferlo's built-in BullMQ support. Do not write your own store.
